title: New Scenery & Airports in MSFS2020 Marketplace ✈️🌍 | Weekly Update | week 35
description:
🔍 Description
🚀 Check out the latest updates in Microsoft Flight Simulator! This week brings several new airports, including updates to Birmingham, Fort McMurray, and Welshpool airports. Additionally, there are some fantastic scenery enhancements to make the world feel even more realistic. Don’t miss the opportunity to explore these exciting updates and improvements!

📹 Other marketplace additions
